items.question: How Can I Play the Canada Lotto Max Lottery?
items.answer: First, depending on where you live, you need to be either 18 or 19 years old. Next, you need to buy a $5 3-play ticket either online or from an approved retailer. Finally, you need to pick seven numbers between 1-50 for each section. Once the draw finishes, you can check the numbers to see if you’ve won.

items.question: How Do I Win the Canada Lotto Max Lottery?
items.answer:
During a drawing, the RNG randomly picks seven numbers. These are the winning numbers, and to get a prize, your chosen numbers should match some or all of them.

There’s a whole range of prizes available, depending on how many correct numbers you’ve picked. If you win, you’ll have 12 months to claim your reward before it expires.

items.question: What Are the Odds of Winning the Canada Lotto Max Lottery?
items.answer: Your odds of picking the winning Canada Lotto Max lottery numbers is one in 33,294,800 for every $5 of play. For MaxMillions, the odds are 1 in 28,633,528.

items.question: When Does the $1 Million Maxmillions Activate?
items.answer: As soon as the main jackpot hits $50 million, MaxMillions will trigger, offering several smaller prize-draws alongside the main lottery.

items.question: Who Won the Biggest Canada Lotto Max Lottery?
items.answer: None of the Canada Lotto Max lottery winners have ever struck it as big as Brampton credit risk manager, Adlin Lewis. The lucky player walked away $70 million richer after winning the grand prize in January 2020.

items.question: When and Where Can I Watch the Canada Lotto Max Lottery Draw?
items.answer:
Draws are conducted every Tuesday and Friday at 9:50 pm Eastern Time.

An RNG (random number generator) picks the winning numbers, so there’s no way to watch the Canada Lotto Max lottery results live. Instead, you can visit the website to see if there are animated videos of the drawing posted.

You can also use the app to see the results of Canada Lotto Max lottery draws. However, if there’s a MaxMillions winner, the public posting of the numbers may be delayed.

items.question: How Do I Cash in Lottery Tickets for the Canada Lotto Max?
items.answer:
For wins under $1,000, you can go to your local retailer with your ticket and customer receipt, where you can use their Canada Lotto Max lottery ticket scanner to determine if you’re a winner.

Anything over the above amount can be claimed by going to an OLG Prize Centre. For any prizes that aren’t cash, you’ll need to contact the OLG Support Centre.

items.question: What Is the Canada Lotto Max App For?
items.answer: You can use the Canada Lotto Max lottery app to get updates on the winning numbers, prizes, or scan your ticket barcode to find out if you’re a winner.
